name: Pure Faithful Hardening
description: Closes b1.7.3's network holes: sounds, skins and logins over HTTPS from Mojang, checked by hash, with no file written outside its folder and no access token sent in cleartext or printed; keeps a log of the client's output in logs/purefaithful.
